issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (see note specifying calculateTotalPrice must be static), but in the provided solution SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice is implemented as an instance method. This mismatch between the specification and the solution's method modifier is structural and can confuse students about whether to implement a static or instance method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make calculateTotalPrice static to match the problem requirements. Change the signature in SealSaloon to 'public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)' and update any internal references or tests to call the static method (e.g., SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal) or via class reference). Ensure the static method still uses the shared static stock field.
